pages.text: The Unawakened Vessel is a basic $(l:weapons/weapon_types)$(c)$(o)Heavy Axe$() that can be crafted from Gluttonous Scales, a bit of wood, Crystallized Bonds and a Concentration Core. It's a decent weapon and quite effective against shields. More importantly, however, it can be awakened with a $(l:materials/blood_feather)$(c)$(o)Blood Feather$() into a $(l:weapons/crescent_disaster)$(c)$(o)Crescent Disaster$().
As a weapon made with a Concentration Core, it's capable of killing $(l:offsprings/angel)$(c)$(o)divine beings$().
